reports.title: FORMFACTOR, INC. REPORTS 2026 THIRD QUARTER RESULTS

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: Dr. Slessor added, “Our fourth-quarter outlook reflects continued broad-based strength in demand. While the productivity gains from our existing manufacturing footprint are moderating as we approach its capacity limits, we are bringing our new Farmers Branch factory online, which will provide additional capacity to support our growth.”
For the fourth quarter ending December 26, 2026, FormFactor is providing the following outlook*:

GAAP | Reconciling Items** | Non-GAAP
Revenue | $285 million +/- $10 million | — | $285 million +/- $10 million
Gross margin | 52.3% +/- 1.5% | $4.9 million | 54.0% +/- 1.5%
Net income per diluted share | $0.84 +/- $0.09 | $0.11 | $0.95 +/- $0.09
